{{Quote
| Those blasted crawbugs are fouling up my roof! I've come up with a clever solution to keep them away, but I'll need some help. Enquire at the Halfway Home if you're fit for the task.

<b>Crawbug Clearing</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that becomes available after defeating [[Widow]]. It can be accepted from the Wishwall in [[Bellhart]] or directly from [[Creige]] at the [[Halfway Home]]. Accepting it from the Wishwall still requires talking to him.

== Wish ==
[[File:Ragpelt.png|link=Ragpelt|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Creige is frustrated by the Craws soiling the roof of the Halfway Home and annoying his customers with their squawks. He asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to kill some Crawbugs, so he can use their [[Ragpelt]] to construct a scarecraw and solve the problem for good.

Ragpelt is dropped in various amounts by [[Craw]]s (1 Ragpelt), [[Tallcraw]]s (2 to 5 Ragpelt), and [[Squatcraw]]s (2 to 5 Ragpelt) in eastern [[Greymoor]]. Creige recommends killing the larger Crawbugs,<ref>"If you're collecting Ragpelt from the crawbugs, those young'ns above here'll be slim pickings. It's the mature craws you want, over by the watermound."</ref> but it can be easier (while more time-consuming) to kill the Craws on his roof, rest at the bench inside the building, then kill the Craws again.

== Reward ==
[[File:Crafting Kit.png|link=Crafting Kit|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After bringing 25 Ragpelt to Creige, he rewards Hornet with a [[Crafting Kit]] upgrade. Creige immediately installs a large scarecraw on top of the tavern, which permanently removes all [[Craw]]s from the rooftop. The scarecraw can be hit, though it cannot be damaged.

{{Clear}}

==Trivia==
*The existence of [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Text#Creige|cut Creige dialogue]] that had clearing this wish while also not freeing Bellhart as prerequisites implies that originally, this wish could be granted before defeating Widow.
